latest.title: AWS DevOps Agent: Aprender del error para automatizar con confianza
latest.description: En el mundo de DevOps existe una frase muy conocida: "Fail fast, learn faster". El objetivo no es evitar los errores por completo, sino detectarlos rápidamente, comprender su causa y convertir cada fallo en una oportunidad para mejorar. Con la llegada de la inteligencia artificial, esta filosofía está evolucionando gracias a los agentes inteligentes para DevOps.

latest.title: Agentes de IA para FinOps: el siguiente paso en la optimización de costos en la nube
latest.description: Exploro cómo los agentes de inteligencia artificial pueden transformar FinOps en AWS, automatizando el análisis de costos, detectando oportunidades de optimización y convirtiendo datos complejos en recomendaciones inteligentes para una mejor toma de decisiones.

latest.title: Why Building Projects Is No Longer Enough: The 2026 Tech Hiring Playbook
latest.description: Building software in private won't cut it anymore—companies want to see how you think, fail, and iterate. This guide outlines how to build a credible online presence and prove your technical skills using real-world cloud architectures.

latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: My AI Pulse — The Agent That Keeps You AI-Ready Before Your Workday Starts
latest.description: Before your workday begins, My AI Pulse scans GitHub, Hacker News, and AWS updates, separates what matters from what is merely loud, and brings you three signals worth knowing. Choose 5, 10, or 15 minutes and turn today’s signal into a skill you can actually use.

latest.title: De un sueño en el aula a construir una comunidad AWS
latest.description: Apasionada por la computación en la nube y el desarrollo de comunidades tecnológicas. Fundadora del semillero de investigación en computación en la nube de UNIMINUTO y líder de **AWS User Group Mosquera**, donde promuevo espacios de aprendizaje, colaboración e innovación. Mi propósito es acercar las tecnologías AWS a estudiantes y profesionales, inspirando a más personas a construir su carrera en la nube mediante eventos, talleres y experiencias prácticas.

latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: Mumu - Personal Daily Intelligence Agent
latest.description: Mumu is a fully serverless personal agent that briefs me every morning, audits my spending every evening. All on its own, on a schedule, with no server to keep alive. It is written in Go, deployed with Terraform, and reasons with Amazon Nova Pro on Amazon Bedrock.

latest.title: An Omikuji App Where Quantum Physics Decides Your Luck

latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: Sift - The AI Agent That Briefs You Every Day

latest.title: Weekend Agent Challenge: PulseAgent

trending.title: AWS Strands Agents vs LangChain: A Practical Guide to Choosing the Right Framework
trending.description:
I learned LangChain at work, then saw AWS Strands Agents' tool-calling loop and wondered: is this the same thing with a different name? 
This article is the real answer, not a spec-sheet comparison, covering who owns the control logic (you vs. the model), boilerplate and debugging, deployment via Bedrock AgentCore vs. self-managed stacks, and a decision checklist for each. Includes a companion repo with both frameworks built side by side, tested live against Bedrock, so you can run them yourself.
